status: Confirmed geometry-preserving QKV fusion speed gain; fused QKV is the native default with a 768 MiB soft allocation budget. Production app remains Core ML.

method.corpus: 48 natural frames plus 16 synthetic tensors, identical production preprocessing
method.metric: Prediction-only time including GPU completion, excluding input preparation and output materialization
method.isolated: Separate processes, normal thermal state, GPU <=55 C and sampled CPU scaled use <=40% before every job; 3x64 frames, one warmup batch
method.paired: Alternating native/Core ML order within adjacent batch-8 pairs; both models resident; three 64-frame rounds; one warmup pair
limitations: No whole-app/end-to-end tagging or sustained-video claim.
Background workloads, power/clock state, memory pressure and compression still vary.
Paired process contains both models; its memory footprint cannot compare standalone backends.
Historical Core ML reached 14.80 fps, emphasizing that absolute rates vary across sessions.
No new GPU trace was recorded during this pass. The earlier one-capture shader-timing limitation remains.

gemmMicrobenchmark.limitations: Isolated GEMM timings include dispatch/evaluation overhead, not a whole-model speed claim.
gemmMicrobenchmark.metric: Median of three rounds, each averaging three synchronized native dispatches
